title: Article 31 — Compulsory acquisition of property (repealed as a fundamental right)

content.heading: Compulsory acquisition of property
content.text: Article 31 as a fundamental right to property was omitted by the Constitution (Forty-fourth Amendment) Act, 1978. Property is now a constitutional legal right under Article 300A.
content.historicalNotes: Do not plead Article 31 as current Part III law.
